caption: The drawing depicts two figures. The larger figure is a bearded man with brown hair and brown skin, dressed in a long, flowing, deep red robe with a gold trim. He is holding a tall wooden staff in his left hand and a small branch with green leaves and white flowers in his right hand. In the crook of his left arm, he is carrying a smaller figure, a child dressed in a white robe with decorative lace at the collar and hem. The child has short, dark hair and is raising its right hand. The background is plain and uncolored, with no additional objects or scenery. The composition is vertical, with the figures centered on the page. In the bottom right corner, there is text that reads “Hazel G. Claflin - 1963.”
title: Carved and Painted Santo - San Jose
